raw.details:
Overview

ENIGMA 5.0 is a National-Level Hackathon organized by CSI SIESGST in collaboration with Rotary, challenging participants to create innovative, technology-driven solutions for problems shaping our future.

Important: This is a one-day offline hackathon. No accommodation will be provided.

The PPT/Submit button will be visible only after the registration fee is paid.

Eligibility

  • Open to all undergraduate students across India.
  • Students from any specialization, including Engineering, Management, Design, etc., can participate.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • Team size: 3–4 members.
  • Each team must nominate one Team Leader for official communication.

Tracks

Participants can choose one track:

  • FinTech
  • HealthTech
  • Sustainability

The selected track must be continued throughout the competition.

Competition Format

Round 1: Idea Submission – PPT Round (Online)

  • Participants can choose any problem statement related to their selected track.
  • Teams must submit their proposed solution in the prescribed PPT format.
  • Submissions must strictly follow the given template.
  • Last date for submission: 18th September.

Round 2: Prototype Development – Offline Hackathon

  • The top 75 teams will be shortlisted for the offline round at SIES Graduate School of Technology, Nerul.
  • Teams will develop a working prototype/MVP during a full-day continuous hackathon.
  • Problem statements will be provided on the day of the hackathon and may or may not be related to the Round 1 problem statement.
  • Teams must continue with the track selected in Round 1.
  • Mentorship sessions will be conducted during the round.

Round 3: Final Presentation & Pitch

  • The top 10 teams will present their solutions before judges and industry experts.
  • Duration: 10 minutes per team, including Q&A.
  • Evaluation will be based on innovation, feasibility, technical depth, and presentation.

Refund Policy

If a team is not shortlisted for the offline round, the registration amount will be refunded as follows:

  • ₹350 for a 3-member team
  • ₹400 for a 4-member team

General Guidelines

  • Participants must adhere to the selected track throughout the competition.
  • All submissions must follow the prescribed format and deadlines.
  • Further instructions and problem statements for the offline round will be communicated to shortlisted teams.
